preprocess_tensor: preprocess a torch tensor by squeezing, reshaping to 2D, and balancing aspect ratio
reshape_to_balanced_aspect: reshape a 2D tensor to a balanced aspect ratio within a max aspect ratio threshold
to_log10: convert a torch tensor to log10 scale with a minimum clamp value
format_log_ticks: format matplotlib axis ticks as powers of 10 in scientific notation
format_stats: format tensor statistics including shape, min, max, mean, and standard deviation as a string
